verification_instructions: 1. dotnet build WorshipPlayer.Presenter --nologo (0 errors). 2. dotnet test WorshipPlayer.Tests --nologo (411+ tests pass).
setup_instructions: Already built and tests pass. No additional setup needed.
environment_constraints: No Docker daemon available. WPF project only builds on Windows target framework (net8.0-windows). CRITICAL: NO implicit styles in XAML (always use x:Key). NO VLC/LibVLCSharp in XAML. All buttons need BorderBrush=Transparent BorderThickness=0.
contribution_requirements: Build must produce 0 errors, all 411 tests must pass. Use VIFCRE before committing.
key_patterns: Panels use UserControl with service properties set from OperatorWindow. OperatorWindow.SwitchToTab() lazily creates panels. PresenterIntegration.cs creates all services and passes them to OperatorWindow. OutputWindow has double-buffered SlideA/SlideB rendering with fade transitions. AlertService/CountdownService fire events that output must subscribe to. Services use async patterns with local JSON/SQLite persistence.
directory_structure: Root: WorshipBacktrackPlayer.sln. Projects: WorshipPlayer.Core (models+services), WorshipPlayer.Audio (engine), WorshipPlayer.Presenter (WPF presenter module), WorshipPlayer.UI (main backtrack app), WorshipPlayer.Tests (xUnit tests). Songs/ folder has song.json files. ServiceOrders/ folder has service order JSON.
